title: The Silver Hand: A Thousand and One

texts.details:
The last grave is not one grave. It is a thousand.

In the Eastern Plaguelands stands Light's Hope Chapel. After Lordaeron fell, a few of our people went out by night and dug up the bodies of its heroes, a thousand of them, and carried them there and laid them under holy ground, so that the Lich King could never have them.

They did not reach everyone. Some of our knights were taken, and raised, and made into the thing we fear most: a paladin turned inside out. A death knight. One such walks the hills west of the chapel. In life he was Sir Dareth of the Silver Hand.

No company, $N. This is between him and one who took the same oath. Go and bring him home.
texts.objectives: Defeat Sir Dareth the Fallen west of Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, alone and with no companions. Return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
texts.progress: Alone. It is between him and one who took the same oath.
texts.completion:
Then there are a thousand and one under that chapel tonight.

You have walked the whole of it now. A founder who saw that mercy must be armed. Zealots who kept the arms and lost the mercy. The Broken, who keep faith with no answer. The first knight, who refused an order. The prince, who gave it. And the dead, whom we would not surrender.

It was at that chapel that Tirion Fordring took up the Ashbringer and joined what was left of our order to the Argent Dawn. The Silver Hand did not end, $N. It became something that lets anyone in who will stand against the dark.

Wear their colors. You have earned them. And take a weapon; you will need it where they are going.

idea: The Silver Hand, level 60: a duel fought alone against a paladin raised as a death knight. From the wiki: about a thousand heroes were reinterred beneath Light's Hope Chapel so the Lich King could not raise them; some fallen paladins became death knights; at the chapel Tirion Fordring reclaimed the Ashbringer and merged his knights with the Argent Dawn into the Argent Crusade. Gives the Tabard of the Argent Dawn. Invented: Sir Dareth.
